Description: The constraint validator emits diagnostics when value, unit, dimension, or provenance is missing or TBD, but it does not validate the supplied dimension identifier against the DEL-02-02 unit DimensionId vocabulary. A constraint quantity can therefore carry explicit but non-canonical dimension metadata, including upstream schema values such as slope, without a unit-contract compatibility finding.
ProposedDisposition: Technical disposition proposed: constraint validation now checks quantity dimension identifiers against the accepted PKG-02 vocabulary, accepts slope, and emits CV-UNIT-DIMENSION-UNKNOWN for retired or noncanonical identifiers. Evidence: python3 -m pytest tests/test_constraint_validation.py passed on 2026-05-16.
